# SPARK Project Analysis Workflow
This is meant to be a complete end-to-end document for running:

1. Amplicon Sequence Variant (ASV) pipeline
2. General statistics
3. Downstream analytics
4. Figure/Table creation

## 1. Amplicon Sequence Variant (ASV) pipeline
This section reviews the steps involved in creating ASVs from raw FASTQ data.

Workflow diagram detailing the flow of data through the steps, software, and associated parameters and configs.

![](./test.png)

---

```{bash}
# Define the environment name
ENV_NAME="spark_env"
ENV_YAML="$PWD/spark_env.yaml"

QI_NAME="qiime2-amplicon-2024.10"

# Check if the environment exists
if mamba env list | grep -q "^${ENV_NAME} "; then
    echo "Environment ${ENV_NAME} already exists."
else
    echo "Environment ${ENV_NAME} does not exist. Creating it..."
    echo "Running: mamba env create -y -n ${ENV_NAME} -f ${ENV_YAML}"
    mamba env create -y -n ${ENV_NAME} -f ${ENV_YAML}
    echo "Environment ${ENV_NAME} has been created."
fi

# Check if the environment exists
if mamba env list | grep -q "^${QI_NAME} "; then
    echo "Environment ${QI_NAME} already exists."
else
    echo "Environment ${QI_NAME} does not exist. Creating it..."
    echo "Running: mamba env create -y -n ${QI_NAME} -c bioconda qiime2-amplicon-2024.10"
    mamba env create -y -n ${QI_NAME} -c bioconda qiime2-amplicon-2024.10
    echo "Environment ${QI_NAME} has been created."
fi
```

Run the ASV pipeline:
```{bash}
MDIR=$(dirname $(which mamba))
source ${MDIR}/../etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate spark_env
./run_vsearch.sh
```

Run General Statistics:
```{bash}
MDIR=$(dirname $(which mamba))
source ${MDIR}/../etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate spark_env
THREADS="$(nproc --all)"

seqkit stat -a -T \
    -o /home/ryan/Projects/UBC/LMP/SPARK_data/vsearch_output/stats/fastq_stats.tsv \
    -j ${THREADS} \
    /home/ryan/Projects/UBC/LMP/SPARK_data/fastq_input/*

seqkit stat -a -T \
    -o /home/ryan/Projects/UBC/LMP/SPARK_data/vsearch_output/stats/fastp_fastqs.tsv \
    -j ${THREADS} \
    /home/ryan/Projects/UBC/LMP/SPARK_data/vsearch_output/fastp/*.fastq.gz

seqkit stat -a -T \
    -o /home/ryan/Projects/UBC/LMP/SPARK_data/vsearch_output/stats/merged_fastqs.tsv \
    -j ${THREADS} \
    /home/ryan/Projects/UBC/LMP/SPARK_data/vsearch_output/merged/*.fastq

seqkit stat -a -T \
    -o /home/ryan/Projects/UBC/LMP/SPARK_data/vsearch_output/stats/filtered_fastqs.tsv \
    -j ${THREADS} \
    /home/ryan/Projects/UBC/LMP/SPARK_data/vsearch_output/filtered/*.fasta

seqkit stat -a -T \
    -o /home/ryan/Projects/UBC/LMP/SPARK_data/vsearch_output/stats/concat_fastas.tsv \
    -j ${THREADS} \
    /home/ryan/Projects/UBC/LMP/SPARK_data/vsearch_output/concat/concat.fasta

```

Run QIIME2 Taxonomic Classifier:
```{bash}
MDIR=$(dirname $(which mamba))
source ${MDIR}/../etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate qiime2-amplicon-2024.10

./qiime_nb_classifier.py \
    -i /home/ryan/Projects/UBC/LMP/SPARK_data/vsearch_output/ASVs/ASVs.fasta \
    -c /home/ryan/Projects/UBC/LMP/SPARK_data/ref_db/2022.10.backbone.v4.nb.sklearn-1.4.2.qza \
    -o /home/ryan/Projects/UBC/LMP/SPARK_data/vsearch_output/taxonomy/ASV_GG2_tax.tsv \
    -s /home/ryan/Projects/UBC/LMP/SPARK_data/vsearch_output/taxonomy/ASV_GG2_stats.tsv \
    -v
```
Run Alpha and Beta Diversity:
```{bash}
MDIR=$(dirname $(which mamba))
source ${MDIR}/../etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate spark_env

python ./calc_div.py
```
